lsc_mutuality.definition: The state in which both sides give and both receive, checked by asking each side what the other gives.
lsc_mutuality.example: There is no mutuality here: one of them does all the giving.

mon_flow.definition: The continuous motion of a fluid.
mon_flow.example: A flow of 2 000 $ a month leaves a stock of 300 $ after the bills.

mt_normative_timing.definition: The age or stage at which a milestone is expected in a given community.
mt_normative_timing.example: The normative timing is what people assume when they do not ask.
